description: The invariants of the rule of sizes (docs/spec/groups.md#invariants) over generated layouts. Each seed starts a generator of mulberry32 at that seed and a grid of one card c1 with options, and runs steps operations, each chosen by the next number u of the generator: below 0.45 an insert of a new card c<n> beside a card picked by the next number toward a side picked by the next number, below 0.7 a withdraw of a picked card, below 0.9 a move, which is a withdraw of a picked card and an insert of it beside another picked card, and otherwise an even. A card is picked as the card at the index of floor(u x count) in the order of the cards of the grid, and a side as left, right, top or bottom at floor(u x 4). checked lists the invariants that the layout library can judge; the others concern the drop targets, the previews, the tabs and the commands of a workbench.
